description: Which billing classes, methodologies and settings hospitals file a (code_type, code) under, and how many hospitals each group has, so a caller can offer the choices before calling list_code_provider_hospitals or get_code_provider_price_distribution. group_by sets what each entry is a group of (default: one set of terms). A hospital filing several groups is counted in each, so don't sum the entries' hospital_count; use the top-level hospital_count for distinct hospitals. Backed by the hospital-prices serving snapshot; fails with UNAVAILABLE until the server has opened one.

code_type.description: Code system the billing code belongs to, e.g. APR-DRG, CDM, CPT, HCPCS, MS-DRG, RC.

group_by.description: Which rows exist: one per billing class + methodology + setting (GROUP_BY_PER_COMBINATION, the default), per billing class, per methodology, or GROUP_BY_ALL (one figure over everything, blending billing classes), or GROUP_BY_FACILITY_PLUS_PROFESSIONAL (one row per methodology and setting the hospital files under both the facility and the professional billing class, the two added together, i.e. the combined bill; terms are methodology and setting, no billing class; no row where there is no professional counterpart). Applied before filter, which may name only the terms the grouping still keeps (e.g. GROUP_BY_BILLING_CLASS with a methodology filter, or GROUP_BY_ALL with any filter, is rejected as INVALID_ARGUMENT).

min_sample_count.description: Only count hospitals whose figure has at least this many billing records (same rule as list_code_provider_hospitals). Negative values are rejected.

name: get_code_provider_terms_summary
title: Summarize the price terms hospitals file a code under
